noticias.titulo: Technology Stocks Remain Central to S&P 500 Performance Despite AI-Related Sell-Off
noticias.resumo:
Sandisk (NASDAQ:SNDK) remained approximately 250% higher for the year, while Dell Technologies (NYSE:DELL) had gained around 160%. 

Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) was up approximately 140% year to date. 

The figures indicate that recent selling has followed a period of considerable appreciation in several AI-related equities.

noticias.titulo: AI Stock Declines Leave Technology Sector as Key Driver of US Equity Market
noticias.resumo:
However, uncertainty about AI infrastructure spending and corporate earnings remains an important consideration. 

## Technology Performance Continues to Shape Market Outlook

Despite recent selling, technology remains the largest component of the S&P 500 and continues to exert considerable influence on the US stock market. 

The sector's substantial gains since October 2022 mean that some investors still hold positions with significant accumulated profits.
